rooms.summary: This might have been a wizard's summoning room, before the dungeon fell to ruin. The floor is still inscribed in places by a broken magic circle, and shards of shattered crystal litter the corners.
features: This might have been a wizard's summoning room, before the dungeon fell to ruin. The floor is still inscribed in places by a broken magic circle, and shards of shattered crystal litter the corners.
tricks: Numerous pressure triggers lie beneath the tiled floor of this room, which cause sounds of running water within the walls
